result.summary: The new SSRF check has a demonstrated cloud-metadata bypass. Targeted tests: 35 passed; two were blocked by read-only filesystem restrictions.

findings.title: Numeric IPv4 notation bypasses the metadata block
findings.body: InstanceConfig(url="http://2852039166", enabled=True) passes the new validator. In web/validation.py:150-171, this hostname misses BLOCKED_HOSTS and ipaddress.ip_address raises ValueError, so it is accepted as DNS. Verified locally that HTTPX preserves this host and socket.getaddrinfo with AI_NUMERICHOST resolves it to 169.254.169.254 without DNS. startup.py:155 passes the accepted URL to ArrClient, whose connection check sends a request to that metadata address. This defeats the metadata restriction this change explicitly introduces.
findings.recommendation: Normalize or reject alternate numeric IPv4 representations before the hostname fallback, then apply the blocked-address checks. Add a regression test rejecting http://2852039166 while preserving supported loopback URLs.

next_steps: Close the numeric-address bypass and rerun config and validation tests.
